source.author: Se3yCake
source.bias_limit: An ambassador/creator example published by the vendor, not an independent controlled benchmark.

version_matching.observed_in_article: P2 and new Smart UV; earlier Tripo on left and Smart UV on right as described in Stage One.
not_disclosed: Generation request IDs, settings and artifact hashes
Identical mesh or input bytes for both sides
version_matching.creation_time_limit: Embedded timestamp is earlier than article publication and is not independent proof of generation date or product version.

artifact.article_location: Stage One, following the paragraph describing left old UV and right new Smart UV.
artifact.source_is: Vendor-published edited comparison clip; not a recording of us operating the commercial Tripo UI.

verification.actual_frame_review: Each extracted full 1920x1080 PNG viewed through tools.view_image with original detail. This is sampled frame inspection, not a claim that a human watched the entire clip.
verification.frame_time_note: frames.json timestamps are requested FFmpeg seek positions; left/right in a full frame share one source frame. No pose, camera or surface normalization was performed.

observations.fact: A single colored stylized character is shown on a graphic background; no editor or UV diagram is visible.

Left character carries a checker test pattern with visible direction/scale discontinuities and promotional negative labels. Right character is still colored and differently posed. This instant is not a matched checker-to-checker comparison.

Both left and right characters display checker patterns simultaneously. Left has visibly fragmented/differently oriented patches around face, neck and limbs. Right shows larger more coherent checker regions across head/torso/legs in this view; transitions remain visible near joints.
observations.limit: The poses and visible surface regions differ. The visual observation does not establish distortion area, texture density, seam count or all-surface quality.

observations.fact: The inspected frames show rendered character surfaces and callout graphics, not a 2D UV editor, packing boundaries, an unwrap operation or real edit handles.
Original clip is decodable end to end with FFmpeg -xerror, exit code 0 and empty error log. No audio stream exists.

author_claims.claim: Left is an earlier Tripo UV result and right is the new Smart UV result; author considers the latter more suitable for tiling.
author_claims.source: Stage One paragraphs around UV video

author_claims.claim: P2 was used for base mesh with a target around 10k–15k quad faces; mesh parts were later downloaded as FBX and refined in Blender.
Some skinning and bone adjustment still required manual work; more complex animation capability remains under exploration.
Smart UV does not remove all seams; close-view head/hands may need manual island work and checker inspection.

inferences.claim: A checker-based asset validation step is relevant before an optional internal 3D asset is textured or rendered into a music-video scene.
inferences.limit: This evidence supports a QA pattern, not adoption or a product architecture change.

inferences.claim: The rendered comparison illustrates appearance differences attributed to UV changes but does not document actual user edit operations.
inferences.limit: Generation/UV-edit provenance and raw data are missing.

unverified: Raw mesh/FBX/GLB pair, identical base geometry/input, exact P2 release and old version
2D UV island layout, overlap, tile utilization, seam placement and packing efficiency
Numeric checker distortion or texel-density consistency over the complete mesh
Controlled lighting, camera, pose, mapping scale and material equality
Actual click-by-click commercial user edit operation, elapsed workflow time and render configuration
Native platform import/edit/save/reopen/render round trip and runtime AI control
Republication/product-ingestion rights to the video and character assets

limits_and_next_steps.media_license: Downloaded as bounded public research evidence only; no product asset ingestion or license clearance.
limits_and_next_steps.real_before_after_status: Published comparison video bytes are verified; actual UV editing workflow and matched raw asset equivalence are not.
limits_and_next_steps.required_for_stronger_claim: Rights-cleared paired FBX/GLB plus exact run/version/settings and actual UI edit capture, then normalized checker views and UV data inspection.
limits_and_next_steps.relevance_limit: 3D remains optional support for music-video production; this task does not make 3D or photos a required creation step.

completion_basis: Original video retrieved within bounds, provenance and dates recorded, all frames decoded, three actual extracted frames reviewed, and limitations documented. No model inference or product acceptance claim.
